{{Quote|There's Chancellor Valorum's shuttle.|[[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]]|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
'''Chancellor Valorum's shuttle''' was a sleek [[Eddicus-class planetary shuttle/Legends|''Eddicus''-class planetary shuttle]] used by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Characteristics==
The shuttle's hull was painted blue with white stripes, as were all shuttles assigned to the Chancellor's office.

==History==
The shuttle was designed by [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Valorum traveled in his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to greet [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] as she arrived at the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on Coruscant to ask for Republic assistance. It was also used to transport the Queen and her entourage just before she left Coruscant.

==Behind the scenes==
The shuttle was designed by Jay Shuster, who only identified it as a "troop transport."
